data.text/markdown:
Gauge ID audit

This app checks only gauge identifiers: the identifier field detected in each source, identifier length counts, and which sources contain the long identifiers. The audit treats gauge_id, Gauge ID, GAUGE_ID, and NetCDF gauge as identifier-name variants. It does not attach HydroATLAS or other attribute columns.

Headline

  • Gauge IDs with length > 7: 0
  • Gauge IDs with length >= 7: 152
  • Identifier fields detected: gauge, gauge_id
